PatientGuide.title: How to find a doctor and request an appointment with RomDoc
PatientGuide.introduction: RomDoc is a medical directory and appointment platform. Start on the <homeLink>RomDoc homepage</homeLink>, choose a specialty and location, review profiles and submit an appointment request.

benefits.title: Why patients use RomDoc

items.title: Search by specialty and location
items.body: Narrow the directory to the type of doctor and area you need.

items.title: Clear public profiles
items.body: Doctor pages can show professional information, clinics, services, prices, verification, reviews and availability.

items.title: Email and SMS notifications
items.body: When enabled, RomDoc can send operational appointment confirmations and reminders.

items.title: One account for appointments
items.body: Authenticated patients can request appointments, track their status, cancel eligible appointments and review history.

benefits.directoryLinks: Explore the <specialtiesLink>medical specialties directory</specialtiesLink> or browse <doctorsLink>doctors available on RomDoc</doctorsLink>.

sms.title: Appointment SMS notifications
sms.description: RomDoc may send SMS messages for appointment confirmation and, when enabled, a reminder approximately 24 hours before the appointment.
sms.privacy: SMS messages are only for appointment logistics and should not include diagnoses, symptoms, medical notes or investigation results.

steps.title: How to search for a doctor step by step

items.title: Open RomDoc search
items.body: Go to the homepage or doctor directory and select the appropriate specialty.

items.title: Choose a location
items.body: Enter an address, locality or landmark and select the search radius.

items.title: Compare profiles
items.body: Review professional information, clinics, services, reviews and verification status.

items.title: Use your patient account
items.body: Appointments require authentication. Confirm your email to access appointment history.

items.title: Submit the request
items.body: Choose the clinic, available date and time, provide your contact details and send the request.

example.title: Example: cardiologist in Bucharest
example.body: A patient can open the <cardiologyLink>cardiology doctors in Bucharest page</cardiologyLink>, compare profiles and continue to the selected doctor.

DoctorStaffGuide.title: User guide for doctors and medical staff
DoctorStaffGuide.introduction: This guide explains appointment management, doctor and authorized-staff roles, SMS notifications and security rules.

items.title: Doctor access
items.body: Doctors manage their appointments, clinics, availability, services and medical information for which they are authorized.

items.title: Authorized staff access
items.body: Active staff can assist the doctor within the assigned role. Access ends when the assignment is disabled.

items.title: Pending
items.body: The patient submitted a request that has not yet been confirmed.

items.title: Confirmed
items.body: The date and time were accepted and the patient may receive operational notifications.

items.title: Rescheduled
items.body: The appointment was moved to another date or time.

items.title: Completed
items.body: The consultation is closed and existing content becomes read-only.

items.title: Cancelled
items.body: The appointment will no longer take place and cannot be modified.

items.title: No-show
items.body: The patient did not attend the appointment.

subscription.title: Doctor subscription
subscription.description: The subscription provides access to the professional profile, services, clinics, availability and RomDoc appointment tools.
subscription.smsNote: Messaging and SMS service costs are separate and are not included in the doctor subscription.

sms.title: Appointment SMS service
sms.description: RomDoc can provide SMS notifications as a separate operational appointment service.
rules: SMS messages are operational notifications, not medical communication.
SMS confirmations may be sent when an appointment becomes confirmed.
The platform may send a reminder approximately 24 hours before the appointment.
The SMS service is billed separately from the doctor subscription.
Unpaid costs may accumulate until the outstanding balance is paid.
The SMS balance may be paid through RomDoc and Stripe when that flow is available.
Messages should not include diagnoses, symptoms, medical notes or results.

manual.title: Fields used by doctors and staff

workflow.title: From confirmation to completion
items: The patient receives email confirmation and, when enabled, SMS confirmation.
The patient may receive a reminder before the appointment.
The patient arrives at the clinic.
The doctor performs the consultation and necessary investigations.
The doctor or authorized staff uploads relevant documents when needed.
The appointment is closed using the completion action.

security.title: Safe use rules
rules: Use only your own RomDoc account and do not share your password.
Check the patient and appointment before uploading a document.
Access only information needed for your professional activity.
Do not export or share documents without an appropriate legal basis and authorization.
Sign out after using a shared device.
